issues.description: Method name/signature mismatch for adding a StockIngredient: the problem UML and the solution expect a method addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) on Stock, but the template Stock class provides addItem(StockIngredient). This difference will cause compilation errors or confusion when students attempt to call addToStockIngredients from SealSaloon as described in the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock API match the specification/solution by renaming addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) in the template, or add an addToStockIngredients method that delegates to addItem. Update the problem text/UML if the intended name is different.

issues.description: Contradictory instructions about the SealSaloon.stock attribute: earlier the problem text instructs students to create a final Stock stock initialized in the constructor (an instance final field), but later explicitly requires the stock attribute to be static (shared across all SealSaloon instances). The solution implements stock as a static final field initialized at declaration. This inconsistency can confuse students about whether to implement an instance final field initialized in the constructor or a static field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the problem statement consistent: explicitly state that stock is a static (class-level) final Stock shared by all SealSaloon instances and show how it should be initialized (e.g., at declaration or in a static initializer). Remove or correct the earlier instruction that implies initializing a final instance stock in the constructor.

issues.description: The problem statement / class diagram specifies a Stock method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) but the template Stock implementation provides a method named addItem(StockIngredient). The solution repository uses addToStockIngredients. This inconsistent naming for the same operation (adding a StockIngredient to the Stock) across artifacts can confuse students when mapping the UML/problem description to the provided template code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock method name match the class diagram/problem and the solution by renaming addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) (or vice versa update the problem text/UML to use addItem), so all artifacts use the same identifier for adding an ingredient to the stock.
